entities.name: Denis Parsons Burkitt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Denis Parsons Burkitt was an Irish surgeon who made significant advances in health, such as the aetiology of a pediatric cancer, now called Burkitt's lymphoma, and the finding that rates of colorectal cancer are higher in those who eat limited dietary fibre.
